scope: Four seeded security behaviors and four matched controls; not a complete audit of all possible bugs.
label_method: Human-authored source-level labels, verified by deterministic behavior checks; never passed to the model.

positives.evidence: Persisted passwords use one fast SHA-256 digest and a global fixed salt; accounts.register stores the result.
Registration records raw passwords and complete email addresses in application logs.
User-controlled directory query is interpolated into executable SQL; admin authorization does not sanitize SQL.
A separate scheduled job exports users' names, emails and phones to an external HTTP endpoint without TLS.

negatives.reason: SHA-256 hashes document bytes for identity, not passwords.
Decision event excludes raw credentials and contact fields; identifiers may still require access/retention controls.
Search input is bound as a query parameter, including embedded SQL punctuation.
PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 applies 600,000 iterations with a per-secret random salt; SHA-256 usage alone is not a finding.

out_of_scope: All possible findings outside the four benchmark categories
